title: Computationally guided high-throughput design of self-assembling drug nanoparticles.
summary: A trained random forest nominated six new drug/excipient pairs; light scattering and microscopy confirmed nanoparticles. Preclinical formulation evidence, not patient efficacy.
organization: Brigham and Women's Hospital; Harvard University; Duke University
